question.text: In-Principle Approval for a Cat III AIF:

answer.text: May be granted by SEBI to speed up registration, before Trust/LLP Deed registration completes
Is granted only after full documentation

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 5.2.4 allows in-principle approval before Trust Deed/Partnership Deed registration completes, to speed up the process. The Trap: Other statements are incorrect. Cross-Exam Context: Same in Cat I/II (XIX-A). Distributor's Pro-Tip: Use in-principle approval to parallelize fund-raising preparation with final legal registration.
